view_limitations: Debt may be understated: a matching but wrong declaration can remove bank debt; participants may support, guarantee or secure debt of left-out entities. See the supported-debt memo and guarantees between participants.
Aggregate cash and EBITDA may not be available to the borrower: structural subordination, partial ownership, restrictions and trapped cash can limit access.
The analyst's attestations are the analyst's own and are not verified; evidence references are not authenticated.
Not a consolidation under IFRS 10 or FRS 102. No accountant reviewed these rules or the output; this says nothing about whether participant accounts are audited.

Read the participants and ownership, left-out and skipped chain entities, eliminations, debt before and after (including amount and percentage removed), refused journals, maturity mismatches, attestations and withholdings.

Debt may also be overstated: unjournalled, excluded or refused loans, intragroup lease liabilities and cash pool positions in overdraft stay in debt. An incorrect attestation may overstate EBITDA. Total debt counts loan_notes, which may include preference shares.
An aggregation covenant result is indicative, not a compliance test under the facility's own definition.
Events after the reporting date, including repayments, forgiveness, new loans, undrawn facilities, keepwells and comfort letters, are not reflected.

Not eliminated: investments against equity, goodwill and minorities, intercompany trade balances, sales and costs, dividends, management charges, unrealised profit, scheduled principal, interest (including accrued), FX and tax.
Trends can mislead when a loan is refused in one period and journalled in another, or when participants change.
A carrying amount net of expected credit losses, or for a below-market loan, can differ and prevent a match.
